title: The racket, to Chloe
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Monday. Wood gives Chloe the speech. Eight sentences about art school as a racket. She lets him finish. Then she asks what the scholarship was for. He says foam core. She says that's not what she asked.

panels.composition: The frame shop. CHLOE at the counter in a rain jacket. WOOD behind it with foam core, talking, the balloon spilling over the panel border.

balloons.text: — a four-year cohort in an air-conditioned loft. Daumier didn't. Melville didn't get an MFA. It's a racket. It's a — it's a racket designed to —
